crossRefs.note: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
Hear me, Yahweh, hear me, that this people may know that you, Yahweh, are God, and that you have turned their heart…
“I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me…
Surely after that I was turned. I repented. After that I was instructed. I struck my thigh. I was ashamed, yes, even…
Turn us to yourself, Yahweh, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.
Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us.
Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.
Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’

translations.web: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
translations.bsb: Restore us, O God, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
translations.kjv: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
translations.asv: Turn us again, O God; And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
